newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore bunkers steady with stable swaps, cargo.
newsitem.headline: Singapore bunkers steady with stable swaps, cargo.

text.p: Singapore bunker prices held steady on Thursday amid stable swap quotes and average enquiries, traders said.
Bunker 380-cst supplies were quoted $96-98 with a major quoting $98.5 per tonne. Bunker 180-cst was indicated at $99-$104.
Traders said cargo prices were expected to stay supported later today and were unsure if levels would rise further after Wednesday's gains.
Gas oil prices hovered between $162-$165 and diesel at $180-$185 per tonne.
